note: Cross-store SKU collisions: one normalized SKU carrying two genuinely DIFFERENT products because store numbering namespaces overlap. Each entry SPLITS the sku: listings matched by split[].listings are re-keyed to split[].key (c:<sku>:<tag>) wherever a data/db row is read (src/utils/sku_collisions.js), before canonical mapping; every other listing keeps the bare sku. listings[] = {storeId} (db-file prefix) or {storeId, url} when one store carries both products. Listed ONLY when the products belong in different canonical groups (a benign collision, e.g. 876891, is not recorded). Candidates: tools/detect_sku_collisions.mjs; validate after every edit: node tools/validate_sku_collisions.js. Plan: docs/sku-collision-split-plan.md.
